description_en: Queries a single log delivery configuration for a hybrid cloud
description_zh: 查询单个混合云日志外发投递配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-log-delivery-config --instance-id waf_elasticity-00000 --delivery-name test1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLogDeliveryConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the log delivery configuration
parameters.name: delivery_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

DeliveryDetail.description_en:
The details of the log delivery configuration, in JSON format.

This parameter is the same as the DeliveryDetail parameter of the CreateLogDeliveryConfig operation. For more information, see [CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~)
DeliveryDetail.description_zh:
外发投递配置内容，以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。

与CreateLogDeliveryConfig接口的DeliveryDetail参数相同。相关描述，请参见[CreateLogDeliveryConfig](~~CreateLogDeliveryConfig~~)接口的外发投递配置内容参数描述

DeliveryName.description_en: The name of the log delivery configuration

DeliveryType.description_en:
The type of the log delivery configuration. Valid values:

syslog: The logs are delivered to a syslog service.

kafka: The logs are delivered to a Kafka service
DeliveryType.description_zh:
外发投递配置类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发到kafka服务
